purpose: Independently acquire and reproduce the fixed NOAA GHCNh weather input inside a disjoint run root

fixed_method.station_map_and_years: Exact ten published stations, all 2025 hours and January/July 2026 hours; 20 station-year Parquet downloads
fixed_method.processing: Call only original weather_hours/hour_grid pure functions and preserve original grid, missingness, fog/deicing flags and float/boolean units

integrity.source_only_published_trust_boundary: User-supplied published source SHA plus matching committed Git HEAD source/spec bytes; source publication must occur before real preparation
integrity.prepared_protocol: parents/weather_protocol.json; publish exact SHA before downloads or value reads
integrity.outputs: Fresh isolated staging, exclusive canonical source files/weather/manifest/producer receipt; never overwrite or resume partial outputs
integrity.source_and_protocol_recheck: Fresh source hashes before/after, each acquired source URL and raw byte SHA, exact saved Parquet value readback, all station-year source reaggregation on verify
integrity.download_boundary: HTTPS www.ncei.noaa.gov only including redirect target; maximum 64 MiB each station-year; 45 second request timeout; at most three transient request/read attempts with one/three second backoff. Each attempt is exclusive and failed bytes remain separate; only a complete response is linked to the staged canonical input.
integrity.same_algorithm_replay_limit: Value replay uses the same pinned public processing functions; it verifies acquisition/output correspondence, not an independent scientific weather oracle
integrity.new_snapshot: NOAA records update; fresh bytes have their own SHA and receipt. Never assert equality to the original weather snapshot or official score transfer.

integration_remaining: Approved organizer raw files and a separate canonical raw/weather input manifest are still required by clean parent producers; this wrapper creates only weather provenance
